observations: Photo 0 shows the underside of a black keyboard with mounting holes, vents, and a label with text and symbols.
Photo 1 shows the keyboard next to its original box, which clearly reads 'Casio Casiotone CT-S300'.
Photo 2 shows the front of the keyboard with white and black keys, a small LCD screen, control buttons, and the 'Casio' and 'Casiotone' branding.
The keys have handwritten notes or numbers on them, possibly for learning or tuning.
The keyboard appears to be in used condition with visible marks and wear, especially on the keys and casing.
The box is intact and matches the keyboard model.

claims.claim: Very clean two month old keyboards
claims.evidence: Photos show visible wear, marks, and handwritten notes on keys, inconsistent with 'very clean' and 'two month old'.

risks.risk: Keyboard may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Video or audio clip showing the keyboard powered on, keys responding, and sound output.

risks.risk: Handwritten notes on keys may be permanent or difficult to remove, affecting resale or aesthetic value.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the keys showing the nature of the writing (e.g., pen, marker, tape).

proof_requests: Video showing the keyboard turned on and playing notes.
Close-up photo of the keys to confirm the type of handwriting or markings.
Photo of the power cord and any accessories included.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a Casio CT-S300 keyboard. The seller's claim of 'very clean' and 'two month old' is contradicted by visible wear and markings. The item can be priced at its worst case (used, with cosmetic damage, unverified functionality) based on the photos. Proof of functionality and condition would improve the price.
